topNews.text: Critically Endangered White-Rumped Vulture Returns to Cambodia Refuge After Years of Effort
topNews.excerpt: A Critically-Endangered and critically important vulture species has been sighted in a Cambodian wildlife sanctuary for the first time in 10 years. After a poisoning incident decimated the local population of white-rumped vultures, there were substantial efforts made to increase the supply of habitat and food, and to reduce the chance of future poisonings. topNews.excerpt: In Queensland, a father of 2 is alive to see his daughters again thanks to a horde of Good Samaritans who rushed to his side after he was pinned under a car during a collision. topNews.text: USA’s Largest Renewable Project Comes Online–With More Power Than the Hoover Dam
topNews.excerpt: The largest renewable energy infrastructure project in US history is fully operational. The SunZia project is expected to generate and deliver more power than the Hoover Dam and be a reliable energy to the western United States for the next 30 years.
